conditions.baselineKind: Historical HTML replay against the same current catalog; expected defects asserted, not a quality pass.
conditions.currentKind: Real installed Chrome driven by the existing local CDP runner; every final case passed.
conditions.notes: Repeated scripted greetings, frame scheduling and the shared host are not controlled performance variables. Render medians are observations, not proof of a general FPS improvement.
conditions.backend: Blocked production Workers, AI, realtime and browser analytics. Any backend response is a named local HTTP fixture.
conditions.resourceUnits: Label RGBA canvas backing bytes; not GPU VRAM. Controller timing covers name/sign updates, not the whole frame.

lighthouse.scope: Snapshot of an opened repository card, not an app-wide or physical-device certificate.

manualCoverage: See readable-town.md: physical safe areas/touch, native IME and screen reader, Safari/Firefox and hardware GPU failure remain manual owner/reviewer checks.
